impacted.role: Holds the votes (content.user_feedback), the per-topic aggregation in get_feedback_statistics that this replaces, the item embeddings (embeddings table and vec_content) and search_content's vector MATCH a similarity carve-out would query.
Scores each item against context.md; already enforces 'Not Interested' topics as priority null, and still accepts the learned-preferences block that learn_from_votes now gates.
analyze_and_store_item evaluates, stores, then embeds; a carve-out applied at scoring time needs the item's embedding before the priority is final.
ContextAnalyzer.analyze_flagged_items is the existing user-triggered path from votes to proposed context.md changes (upvotes only today).
The automatic votes-to-context.md rewriter now gated by learn_from_votes; its backup_context keeps timestamped copies of context.md, the only history of context changes today.
The TUI's :context suggest copies proposals to the clipboard and :context edit opens context.md in $EDITOR; the user applies changes by hand.
POST /api/context/suggest drives ContextAnalyzer; GET /api/feedback/statistics exposes the per-topic counts.

constraints.text: The evaluator prompt already makes 'Not Interested' topics return priority null, so an exclusion written into context.md is applied by existing scoring with no new code path.

gpt-5.4-nano applies prompt lines literally (b6c3f70, and the #96 dislike list), so a carve-out written as prose risks being read wider than the slice it names; a carve-out applied by prose needs its own measured check that the category's other items keep their priority.
analyze_and_store_item calls evaluate_content before create_or_update_content, and generates the embedding from the summary only after storing (around the 'Indexed for semantic search' print).
search_content already runs a vec_content MATCH over the stored 384-dimension item embeddings, the primitive a nearest-downvoted-item check would reuse.

Measured 2026-10-15: the one downvoted item's nearest neighbors (cosine 0.52-0.62) are a coherent 'AI agents behaving badly' incident-news cluster, most scored High; the closest upvoted item is at 0.46.
With one downvote on record, real data cannot calibrate a similarity radius or show that a cluster generalizes; the 'more than one downvote in the slice' rule has no observed instance yet.
analyze_flagged_items reads upvoted items and asks an LLM for topics to add, validated per suggestion; it never reads downvotes.
The TUI copies context suggestions to the clipboard; nothing writes them into context.md, records that they were accepted, or keeps a history of what changed.

backup_context writes timestamped full copies of context.md (backup_count, default 10) before the auto-updater overwrites it; there is no diff, no record of why a line changed, and nothing shows the history to the user.
learn_from_votes gates both the evaluator's learned preferences and the auto-updater (context_auto_update_active); votes keep being recorded while it is off.
The earlier feedback-loop spec's vision is 'context.md evolves automatically ... No manual context editing required', with user effort limited to voting.
rudy's 2026-10-15 direction (optional or user-triggered, always visible) supersedes the spec's fully automatic loop, so the spec misdescribes intent once this ships and needs updating with it.

Prior art: Feedly Leo's 'Less like this' corrects the match ('Not about <topic>') rather than disliking the topic, and its mute filters preview the matching articles before saving; scrutable recommenders (arXiv 2402.05810, MoRe) keep the learned profile as editable natural language the user can read and change.

related.query: gh issue list --state open --search "context OR vote OR feedback OR interest" --limit 15

issues.why: Drift detection; a carve-out that over-applies would show as the same unprioritized-share jump, so #97 is the guard on this feature too.
Multi-context profiles; carve-outs belong to a context, so their storage should not assume one global context.md.

reuse.what: The existing 'Not Interested' rule, if a carve-out is written into context.md.
search_content's vec_content MATCH and the stored item embeddings, if a carve-out is applied by similarity.
The user-triggered propose-and-validate flow, extended from upvotes to downvote clusters.
backup_context and check_context_md for writing context.md safely.
The analyze priority command, to re-score items after a carve-out is accepted.
